thesis: Decision-critical historical facts are supported by PayPal's FY2025 10-K and Q2 2026 10-Q/8-K. Revenue, TPV, active accounts, OCF, capex, SBC, buybacks, debt and liquidity are directly observable. The main uncertainty is whether branded-checkout stabilization turns into durable moat stabilization.

evidence.claim: FY2025 revenue $33.172B, OCF $6.416B, capex $852M and SBC $1.002B are filing-backed.
Q2/H1 revenue, TPV, OCF, SBC and repurchases are filing/company-reported.
5Y valuation percentile is externally sourced and cross-checked with current P/E versus 5Y average.

counterevidence: The 10-year owner-FCF paths are model estimates.
The valuation percentile source is updated 2026-08-22 rather than exactly 2026-09-18.
falsifiers: Any later filing that materially revises frozen facts requires rerun.
